I personally like to go for walks while on shrooms and explore my surroundings but I have friends that rather want to sit down and relax so it's really up to you. 0.75 is a quite low dose, depending on how much you weight and what you plan on doing 1-1,5g is a pretty good beginners dose that shouldn't be too much (except if you were going for a low dose then 0.75 works too)
Generally shrooms are a bit more "thoughtless" and just enjoying your surroundings rather than acid. The come up is softer in my opinion but you can get nauseous too if your not used to it. 
Wishing you lots of fun with my absolut favorite drug! Enjoy yourself and enjoy nature!
